personal_relief.ref: IRA 2017 s.52, Fifth Schedule para 1 (as amended by Act No. 45 of 2022)

bands.ref: IRA 2017 First Schedule para 1(1)(a) (as amended from 1 April 2023)

rent_relief_rate.ref: IRA 2017 s.52 / Fifth Schedule: relief of 25% of rental income

foreign_service.ref: The 15% maximum rate on qualifying foreign service income applies from 1 April 2025 (YA 2025/26); confirm the treatment for YA 2024/25

qualifying_payment_cap.ref: IRA 2017 s.52 & Fifth Schedule: qualifying payments are subject to limits - enter the allowable amount

standard_rate.ref: IRA 2017 First Schedule para 2(1) (30% from 1 October 2022)

qualifying_export_services.label: 15% - Qualifying Export Service Income

standard_rate.label: Partnership income tax rate
standard_rate.ref: IRA 2017 s.53 and First Schedule (as amended): tax on a partnership's taxable income; the partners are taxed on their shares as individuals - to be validated

balancing.label: Balancing charge / allowance on disposal
balancing.ref: IRA 2017 Third Schedule & s.17-18: proceeds against the tax written-down value - confirm the treatment

intangibles.label: Intangible assets
intangibles.ref: IRA 2017 Third Schedule: over the useful life - enter the allowance

carry_forward_years.label: Years a loss may be carried forward
carry_forward_years.ref: IRA 2017 s.19 - confirm the limit for the year

restriction.ref: IRA 2017 s.19: business and investment losses carried forward; confirm any restriction for the category

dividend_final.ref: IRA 2017 s.84 / Fifth Schedule (final WHT on dividends to residents)

interest.ref: IRA 2017 s.85 (AIT/WHT on interest - creditable for most persons)
